t: In front of you is the Lady Henry Somerset Memorial, also known as the Lady Henry Somerset's Children's Fountain. It stands in Victoria Embankment Gardens and has been Grade II-listed since 24 February 1958. It remembers Lady Henry Somerset, a philanthropist, temperance leader and campaigner for women's rights. She was president of the British Women's Temperance Association, and she spoke at the first World's Woman's Christian Temperance Union convention in Boston in 1891. The memorial was made by the sculptor George Edward Wade, who is best remembered for his statues of royalty and politicians.
